Loadouts are premade, map is Winter, and is 12 waves|In-game Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Classic Winter''' was the second [[Maps|map]] of [[The Classic Event]]. It has been made available again through the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. Like other event maps, this map has a specialized wave structure with special enemies. Triumphing this map rewarded the player with {{Token|1}}. There was also {{Tix|1}} on the map, which could be found left of the enemy entrance. This map has a premade loadout. It consists of the [[Military Base]], [[Militant]], [[Freezer]], [[Crook Boss]] and [[Sniper]]. Skins and golden perks could not be applied to these towers without the use of bugs, though this is not the case in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. This map had four modifiers. The first was [[Enemies Beta]], which changed the appearance of some enemies. The second was [[Classic Roblox]], which activated the next two modifiers on the map. The third modifier aws [[Classic Oof]], which made enemies play the old Roblox death sound. The fourth was [[Retro Death]], which made enemies collapse into multiple pieces upon death. When activated in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only [[Classic Oof]] and [[Retro Death]] are applied. ==Design & Path== '''Classic Winter''' takes place in a snowy, flat area surrounded by hills. Multiple cliffs can be found on the map, which act as cliff spots for towers. There are trees scattered across the map. A few houses can also be seen on the map. The brown path begins and ends at two snow caves at two of the snow mounds. The path takes a long straight before doubling back on itself twice. The map slowly corrupted itself, turning parts of the map into a dark black color, and making other objects float in the sky. This no longer happens in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ==Interactive Maps== {{Map:Classic Winter}} ==Event Rewards== The game calculated how many {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 100% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned was multiplied by 2x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplied any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. Any rewards that ended in a decimal point were rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. Rewards were calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:1em auto" !Coins Reward !EXP Reward |- |({{Coins|100}} ÷ (1 + [(12 ÷ Current Wave) - 1]^1.3) + {{Coins|100}} (Triumph Only)) × 1.3 |({{Exp|30}} ÷ (1 + [(12 ÷ Current Wave) - 1])) × 1.3 |} ===Badges=== There were also a few [[badges]] which could be obtained when playing this map, which may have had additional rewards alongside the [[Badges|badge]]. These were: {{Badge |title = Premium 2 |image = PremiumBadge.png |obtainable = No |rewards = {{Token|1}} }} {{Badge |title = Tix 2 |image = TixBadge.png |obtainable = No |rewards = {{Tix|1}} }} ==Wave Structure== Wave bonus is calculated as: :{{Money|100}} + (Waves Completed × {{Money|950}})^0.99 Wave clear bonus is 35% of the wave bonus. '''Bolded''' names indicates an enemy type's debut.

==Strategy== *The [[Military Base]] is very effective on this map due to its units having high DPS, high HP, and its ''Airstrike'' ability. **In fact, you can just use the [[Military Base]] alone and it will be able to beat this map. *The [[Militant]] can be useful against enemies that spawn on this map, due to its decent DPS. ==Trivia== *This map is based on the first version of [[Winter]], a map that has been replaced by [[Winter Abyss]]. ==Update History== *'''23 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0]] **'''Classic Winter''' added. **{{Bug}} Towers can have other skins if the tower is equipped in the lobby. *'''28 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0|v1.23.3]] **'''Classic Winter''' removed. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''Classic Winter''' re-added, to [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode only. **{{Bug}} Wave structure turns into regular modes after the final wave. **{{Bug}} {{Tix|}} no longer spins. **{{Bug}} Map no longer corrupts. **{{Bug}} [[1x1x1x1]] no longer has a model. {{TheClassicMaps|[[Classic Candy Cane Lane]]|Mission 1|[[Classic Winter]]|Mission 2|[[Classic Forest Camp]]|Mission 3}} {{MapNavBox}} [[Category:Sandbox Only Maps]]
